name: suppressed-baseline-errors
method: Bucketed every entry in phpstan-baseline.neon by error pattern. Counted phpcs.xml `<exclude name=...>` rules grouped by category (commenting, security, naming, db).

buckets.pattern: Parameter #1 $text of function esc_(html|attr) expects string, (int|float|int<1,max>) given
buckets.fix_pattern: Cast to (string) at the echo site or use (string) wrapper before esc_html()
buckets.severity: low — runtime PHP coerces; phpstan strict-type only

buckets.category: Constant MVS_PLUGIN_DIR / MVS_PLUGIN_URL not found by phpstan
buckets.fix_pattern: Add `define()` to the plugin bootstrap section that phpstan can statically resolve, or stub via includes/Stubs/Constants.stub.php
buckets.severity: low — phpstan visibility issue; constants exist at runtime

buckets.category: Always-true / always-false ternary or condition (dead code)
buckets.pattern: Ternary operator condition is always true / Left side of && is always true / Negated boolean expression is always (true|false) / If condition is always true
buckets.fix_pattern: Each is a single-occurrence simplification; remove the redundant guard
buckets.severity: low-medium — dead code can mask future bugs

buckets.category: Parameter #1 $args of function (paginate_links|wp_dropdown_pages|...) expects array{...}, array{...} given
buckets.fix_pattern: Tighten the array shape passed to WP function calls
buckets.severity: low — WP functions accept extra keys; phpstan strictness only

buckets.fix_pattern: Either tighten upstream return type to WP_Error|T or remove the redundant is_wp_error() guard

buckets.category: WP_Screen ?? null on non-nullable string property
buckets.pattern: Property WP_Screen::$id (string) on left side of ??
buckets.fix_pattern: Drop the ?? '' since $id is non-nullable; use empty string compare instead

buckets.pattern: Method WPMediaVerse\... return type / Method WPMediaVerse\... has parameter ...

buckets.category: Function WP_CLI / buddypress / groups_get_current_group not found
buckets.fix_pattern: Already gated via class_exists/function_exists at runtime; phpstan-baseline shields. Add to phpstan stubs if more accurate analysis is desired.

buckets.category: Property / object access on undefined property
buckets.pattern: Access to an undefined property object

buckets.category: Other (Return type, Result of, Property WPMediaVerse, Offset 'safe')

buckets.rationale: WBcom convention — docblocks not enforced; class/function names self-document
Custom tables (mvs_*) require direct $wpdb access; values are still passed through $wpdb->prepare() (Coding Rule #3 enforces this at the bin/ci-local.sh level)

REST endpoints handle nonces via permission_callback; admin-post handlers use wp_nonce_field; .Missing is overzealous false-positive on REST handlers. Coding Rule #7 + journeys cover the real surface.
Modern PHP/PSR-4 conventions; Yoda is style-preference
Required for hook callback signatures with unused $arg slots

buckets.category: Other (DontExtract, NoSilencedErrors, CommentedOutCode, UnnecessaryStringConcat, DisallowLonelyIf, NoReservedKeywordParameterNames)

buckets.rationale: Defines mvs/MVS prefixes, wpmediaverse text domain, and 8 custom capabilities so the sniffer recognizes them

notes: Health summary: phpstan baseline is stable (no growth post-1.2.0; no new entries added during the version refresh — 1.2.0 code passes phpstan level 5 cleanly). phpcs.xml exclude set is wide but each is justified per the rationale column; the strict surface (Coding Rules + bin/ci-local.sh + journeys) catches what the sniffer omits. The largest single bucket (esc_* type-coercion, n=11) could be retired in a half-day pass if desired — purely (string) cast additions. The 'always true' bucket (n=13) is real dead-code worth a focused cleanup PR but not a 1.2.0 ship blocker.
